items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: I just did an album with Banu Gibson. And my band did about six or seven of the tracks with her.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's incredible. But that's been going on for many years.

Nowadays, you can... I just did an album with Banu Gibson. And my band did about six or seven of the tracks with her. And the rest of the tracks were some material that she had done a few years ago. On one of the tracks, they had an open. And there was just... I don't know if there was anything on it originally between the two vocal choruses. But there was an open chorus with just a piano comping chords and a bass and a drum. And so I went in with the phones and they put me in a booth. And I did a chorus of After…
Yeah, well, they work very hard at that. You can run into some real problems.
